name: session-status
description: See at a glance which Claude chats are working ⏳, need you 💬, are done ✅ or failed ⚠️: a live marker and step count on each chat in the desktop app's sidebar, plus a /sessions board of every chat. No pop-ups.

markers.title: Sidebar markers
markers.description: The marks put before each chat's title in the desktop app's sidebar. A: ⏳ working, 💬 needs you, ✅ done, ⚠️ failed. B: 🔹 🔸 ✔️ ❗. C: 🔵 🟡 🟢 🔴. off: no marks.

renamedChats.title: Chats you renamed
renamedChats.description: update: keep the marker current in a chat you renamed; the app asks you to approve each change, and saying no stops it for that chat. leave: never rename a chat you named, so a marker kept in your name can go out of date.
